about: Live's transport as a Max for Live device reads it at every sample, recorded in Live 12.4 by device_timing_live --record. phase: plugphasor~ as runs of [from sample, value, step per sample]: the value as it is on the run's first sample, then the fraction of value plus step times samples since (a step of 0 holds the value). sync: plugsync~'s [vector, song position in beats, play flag, tempo] on each signal vector where they aren't what the vector before puts them (the same, the position on by a vector at the tempo while playing).

scenes.name: restart
scenes.what: played from the start, stopped 3.185 s in, played again (from the start) and stopped

scenes.name: restart-six
scenes.what: stopped 3 s in and moved to beat 6 while stopped, then played again (from the start)

scenes.name: continue-mid
